content: XLSX lib for server-side Node generation: write-excel-file v4.1.1 (npm publish Jun 2026, 1.8MB, write-only, active) exposes write-excel-file/node with writeExcelFile(sheetData).toBuffer() and per-cell type/format/fontWeight/align plus columns[].width. SheetJS CE on npm is stale 0.18.5 (real releases only on cdn.sheetjs.com; known CVEs in npm version) — poor supply-chain fit for an internal app that hand-rolls CSV by design. exceljs 4.4.0 (Dec 2024, 21.8MB) richest styling but explicit maintenance-inactivity concerns (issue #2884). Recommendation: write-excel-file.
